run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend-proxy since 2026-11-15T07:39:13Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert for otel-demo/frontend-proxy is firing because frontend-proxy returns HTTP 500 on the checkout path: its ingress and 'router frontend egress' spans carry error=true/http.status_code=500 whose volume rose from ~1-6 per 5m (07:18-07:38) to ~135-146 per 5m from 07:44 onward. The chain visible in the sampled traces is frontend POST /api/checkout (500) -> frontend grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (rpc.grpc.status_code=13) -> checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder -> checkout client span HTTP POST (child of prepareOrderItemsAndShippingQuoteFromCart) -> shipping /get-quote (Internal Server Error) -> shipping client span 'POST quote' (otel.status_description=Timeout, ~5.0005s). The deepest failing edge is therefore the shipping-to-quote HTTP POST; shipping's deployment sets QUOTE_ADDR=http://quote:8080 and quote's server span is 'POST /getquote'. Quote itself shows no error-status spans and its served requests have p50 ~1 ms, and the failing calls never reach it (shipping successes ~27.8/5m exactly match quote's ~27.8/5m while ~135-146/5m time out). At 2026-11-15T07:39:07Z, 6 seconds before the alert start (07:39:13Z), a Chaos Mesh Schedule 'otel-demo-email-checkout-network-partition' (chaos-mesh namespace) began spawning NetworkChaos objects every minute (last spawn 07:48:07Z, each Started/Applied then TimeUp/Recovered ~55s later), and source.component=podnetworkchaos events were recorded on exactly two pods: quote-6b5877698d-8fn9w and shipping-75d58f5d84-jgxvv. No pod restarts, no terminated containers, no rollout, and no CPU saturation were found, so crash, deployment change and resource exhaustion are rejected. The exact NetworkChaos spec (selector/direction/delay-vs-loss/duration) could not be read with the authorized resource kinds, so the precise fault parameters are unknown.

claims.text: frontend-proxy's own error spans rose sharply after 07:39: traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="frontend-proxy",span_name="ingress",status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"} increase over 5m was about 1.1-5.6 per 5m for every sample from 07:18:01Z to 07:38:01Z (baseline after the environment's first metrics at 07:16:01Z), then 13.33 at 07:40:01Z, 80.0 at 07:42:01Z, 136.67 at 07:44:01Z and 132-146 per 5m through 07:52:01Z; span_name="router frontend egress" tracked it (10.0 at 07:40:01Z up to 132-145 per 5m).

The failing requests are HTTP 500s. In sampled error traces, frontend-proxy spans 'ingress' and 'router frontend egress' carry error=true, otel.status_code=ERROR and http.status_code=500, with full parent references: load-generator POST -> frontend-proxy ingress -> router frontend egress -> frontend POST -> frontend POST /api/checkout -> frontend 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout' -> frontend grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (rpc.grpc.status_code=13) -> checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (rpc.grpc.status_code=13) -> checkout HTTP POST (client) -> shipping /get-quote (otel.status_description="Internal Server Error") -> shipping 'POST quote' (otel.status_description="Timeout", duration_us 5001336; server span duration_us 5001391).

The propagated gRPC error text on frontend 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout' and on checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder is exactly "13 INTERNAL: shipping quote failure: failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 500" (exception.type 13), so the call that fails is the shipping quote step performed inside prepareOrderItemsAndShippingQuoteFromCart.

The failing checkout client span named 'HTTP POST' has parent spanID 2cae7d1ff37f6f7c, which is checkout's 'prepareOrderItemsAndShippingQuoteFromCart' span, i.e. it is the shipping call of the quote step, not the order-confirmation email call. The shipping deployment's env sets QUOTE_ADDR=http://quote:8080, and the quote service's server span operation is 'POST /getquote'.

The failing shipping->quote calls do not reach the quote service: quote's spans ('POST /getquote', 'calculate-quote', '{closure}') fell from ~166.7 per 5m at 07:37:01Z to 62.5 (07:43:01Z) and 27.78 per 5m from 07:45:01Z, exactly matching shipping's successful 'POST quote' / '/get-quote' STATUS_CODE_UNSET counts (27.78 per 5m), while shipping's 'POST quote' and '/get-quote' STATUS_CODE_ERROR counts were 133-146 per 5m.

The quote service was not itself slow or erroring on the requests it served: histogram p50 of traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{service_name="quote",span_name="POST /getquote"} was 1 ms in the 5m ending 07:50:01Z, and quote's container logs keep printing 'Calculated quote' from 07:40:02Z through 07:49:02Z (60 newest of 224 lines).

Per-service error-span increases (status_code=STATUS_CODE_ERROR) at 07:44:01Z and 07:50:01Z were: shipping '/get-quote' 131.8/134.4 and 'POST quote' 131.8/134.4 per 5m; checkout 'oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder' 130.8/131.1 and 'HTTP POST' 130.8/131.1; frontend 'POST /api/checkout', 'POST' and 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout' and 'grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder' 126.7-133.3; frontend-proxy 'ingress' 136.7/135.6 and 'router frontend egress' 135.6/132.2. In the same results the returned series for ad, fraud-detection, payment, accounting and recommendation were 0, and no error-status series for service_name email or quote were returned at all.

Chaos Mesh is installed in the cluster (namespace 'chaos-mesh' is Active). In the chaos-mesh namespace a Schedule named 'otel-demo-email-checkout-network-partition' (source.component schedule-cron, reason Spawned) created NetworkChaos objects every minute starting 2026-11-15T07:39:07Z: -9xnx8 (07:39:07Z), -nz4lm (07:40:07Z), -85v74 (07:41:07Z), -rw58g (07:42:07Z), -lwvxl (07:43:07Z), -769cj (07:44:07Z), -q7g8w (07:45:07Z), -fsflv (07:46:07Z), -5ks6l (07:47:07Z), -5czjs (07:48:07Z); each shows Started/Applied and then TimeUp/Recovered about 55 seconds later.

The pod-level network chaos landed on exactly the two pods of the failing edge: in otel-demo, events with source.component=podnetworkchaos and message 'Successfully update ObservedGeneration and FailedMessage of resource' target only quote-6b5877698d-8fn9w and shipping-75d58f5d84-jgxvv, from 2026-11-15T07:39:07Z through 07:48:07Z, twice per minute (at :02 and :07).

Before the fault the checkout path was working: checkout spans sampled at 07:30:14-17Z on trace f81debdeb0a4ed42b9c61d919737c3db, 68e43908b62a1d4c29af9e39c85b1cf9 and a2b654a491404c59c726a9d8fdff8922 had oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder with rpc.grpc.status_code=0 and 'HTTP POST' client spans with no error status.

All 21 otel-demo pods are Running and ready with restartCount 0 and no lastState.terminated reason or exit code (including quote-6b5877698d-8fn9w, shipping-75d58f5d84-jgxvv, email-59f69bc6cf-8z5c5, checkout-5dccddf8bb-pd7qk, frontend-proxy-6b4d584985-wvxht), and the only events in the namespace are the 38 normal podnetworkchaos 'Updated' events.

No rollout explains the onset: each of quote, shipping and email has a single ReplicaSet (quote-6b5877698d, shipping-75d58f5d84, email-59f69bc6cf) owned by its Deployment and created at 07:02:24-07:02:25Z, well before 07:39.

No resource saturation on the quote pod at 07:50:01Z: container_cpu_usage_seconds_total rate for pod quote-6b5877698d-8fn9w container quote was 0.000257 cores and the CFS throttled-periods ratio was 0.0606 (email 0.0463/0.0533, shipping 0.0385/0.0564 for container/pod level).

Shipping's client latency on the failing edge matches a timeout, not a slow application response: histogram p50 of traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{service_name="shipping",span_name="POST quote"} was 7004 ms in the 5m ending 07:50:01Z, and the sampled spans are 5.0005s.

Email was not the failing component, although the error text names it: no error-status span series was returned for service_name email in either the 07:44:01Z or 07:50:01Z per-service error query, and email's 'POST /send_order_confirmation' and 'send_email' spans remained STATUS_CODE_UNSET, falling from ~169 per 5m to 27.78 per 5m in step with shipping's '/ship-order' (171.1 -> 27.78 per 5m), i.e. only because fewer orders reach that stage.

Primary cause: the Chaos Mesh network fault applied to the quote and shipping pods from 07:39:07Z (Schedule 'otel-demo-email-checkout-network-partition') broke the shipping->quote HTTP connection path so that ~133-146 per 5m 'POST quote' calls per 5m exceeded shipping's ~5s client timeout (status description 'Timeout', 5.0005s) and never reached quote; shipping's /get-quote then returned 500, which propagated as gRPC status 13 through checkout PlaceOrder and frontend POST /api/checkout to frontend-proxy ingress 500s, raising RequestErrorRate. Correlation plus mechanism are supported by the exact pod-level chaos events and the exact failing edge, but the NetworkChaos spec (target selector, direction, delay vs loss, correlation, duration) was not readable, so this remains the best-supported explanation rather than a fully verified one.

Unresolved secondary point: the shipping quote failure text says 'failed POST to email service', while shipping's configured quote target is QUOTE_ADDR=http://quote:8080 and the failing calls correspond to quote's 'POST /getquote' endpoint. This wording (possibly a hard-coded/misnamed message in the shipping image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-shipping) could not be verified because the application source and image are not readable here; it does not by itself indicate the email service is failing.

Rejected: a pod crash, OOMKill, eviction or readiness failure caused the errors. All 21 otel-demo pods are Running and ready with restartCount 0 and no lastState.terminated reason/exit code, and no Evicted/OOMKilled/BackOff/Failed/Unhealthy event exists in the namespace; the only events are normal podnetworkchaos 'Updated' events.

Rejected: a deployment/rollout change at 07:39 introduced the errors. Each of quote, shipping and email has a single ReplicaSet created 07:02:24-07:02:25Z owned by its Deployment, and the pods' startTime is 07:02:24-07:02:26Z with zero restarts, so no new revision appeared at incident onset.

Rejected: CPU throttling or resource exhaustion in quote made it too slow to answer. At 07:50:01Z the quote container used 0.000257 cores with a 0.0606 CFS throttled-periods ratio, and quote's served 'POST /getquote' requests had p50 1 ms, so slowness is not explained by its own resource use or application latency.

gaps: The NetworkChaos / Schedule resource spec (target selectors, direction, delay vs loss percentage, correlation, duration) could not be read: NetworkChaos, PodNetworkChaos and Schedule are not among the authorized Kubernetes kinds, so the exact fault type behind the 5s timeouts is unknown.

Why the offending Schedule is named 'otel-demo-email-checkout-network-partition' while the pod-level PodNetworkChaos records are on the quote and shipping pods (and not on email or checkout pods) is unexplained; the object spec would be needed to check its targetSelector.

The RequestErrorRate alert rule definition could not be retrieved: list_prometheus_rules returned no_data both for rule_name=RequestErrorRate and for {alertname="RequestErrorRate"}, so how the annotated value 0.6444444444444444 was computed, and why the threshold is '> 0', could not be verified.

No traces_span_metrics series for frontend-proxy exist before 07:16:01Z in the authorized window, so there is no baseline older than the 07:17-07:38 low-error period; the pre-environment baseline is unknown.

Error traces for frontend-proxy between 07:50:41Z and 07:57:01Z returned no matching trace (status no_data — an empty result is not proof of absence), and trace-metric series for all services drop to 0 at 07:56:01Z simultaneously, so whether the fault is still active or has recovered cannot be certified from metrics; the last observed 500 traces are at ~07:50:40Z and the last chaos event at 07:48:07Z.

Prometheus scrape health could not be checked: get_prometheus_target for job 'otel-collector' returned no active targets and an empty jobs_seen (status no_data), so the 07:56:01Z zeroing of all trace-metric series cannot be attributed to a scrape stop versus a counter reset.
kube_deployment_status_replicas_available/ready returned no data for namespace otel-demo at 07:50:01Z, so workload-level readiness could only be judged from pod status, not from deployment metrics.
A networkpolicies query for otel-demo returned no items (status no_data), so the presence or absence of Kubernetes NetworkPolicies cannot be stated.

Application logs did not corroborate the failure: shipping container logs had 979 lines in 07:35-07:57 but zero lines matching err|error|fail|exception|panic|timeout|refused (read only through 07:49:12Z), and the email container returned no log lines at all for that window.

Change history is not integrated in this Run, so any pre-window configuration change (for example the creation time of the chaos Schedule) cannot be examined beyond the events and object states that were readable.
No own error or latency evidence was examined for kafka, valkey-cart, postgresql, flagd, otel-collector or image-provider; they remain unchecked for this incident.
next_steps: Advisory: read the Chaos Mesh Schedule and NetworkChaos objects (namespace chaos-mesh, names 'otel-demo-email-checkout-network-partition' and its spawned NetworkChaos objects) to confirm the target selector, direction, delay/loss parameters and duration, and decide whether this injected partition should be paused or deleted.

Advisory: after removing the chaos, re-check shipping 'POST quote' latency and status plus frontend-proxy ingress http.status_code=500 volume against the 07:17-07:38 baseline (about 1-6 error spans per 5m) to confirm the path returns to normal.

Advisory: retrieve and review the RequestErrorRate alerting rule (target Prometheus, not currently loaded in the queried rule set) to document which metric and window produce the reported 0.6444444444444444 value.
Advisory: check Prometheus scrape targets / OTel collector health to explain why every service's trace-metric series falls to 0 at 07:56:01Z, so recovery or continued failure can be determined.

Advisory: consider tightening the client/server timeout and error budget on the shipping->quote call (5s client timeout produced 5s checkout latency and HTTP 500s) and align the misleading 'failed POST to email service' error text with the actual quote target.
